package.name: plansys2_epddl_grounder
package.description: The EPDDL front end: turns an EPDDL domain, problem and action-type libraries into the grounded task JSON that plansys2_epistemic_planner and the epistemic state read, by running the `plank export` toolchain as a subprocess. This is what lets a launch file be given .epddl sources, the way classical PlanSys2 is given a .pddl domain, rather than a grounded task produced by hand outside the workspace.
